title: Planner: save AI-generated filters in Planner Agent chat
summary: Hold: the briefing attributes a Planner Plan 1 requirement for creating premium plans to an admin page that no longer states it. The roadmap facts and Planner Agent access commands are supported, but the licensing model also understates the documented Microsoft Copilot requirement.
